description: Use this when the person needs the QR code, QR image or GS1 Digital Link of one of their own products for a label or package. Returns the permanent QR link of a product of the connected account (/q/<code>, it exists from the moment the product is created and never changes), the GS1 Digital Link if the product has a GTIN, the addresses of the QR image as PNG and SVG and the print sheet in the dashboard. Do not use for products of other manufacturers (use resolve_product).

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

product_id.description: Product id, as list_my_products returns it

name: get_qr_link
title: QR link of a product
